Good things first: HWs are really amazing. They actually contribute to a students understanding of science and research as it exactly what it wants and I think they are tailored to be fun and interesting at the same time. I think the exams should also be similar to HWs, as this course should evaluate the logical perception of the students on the science of biology. Unfortunately, although I feel bad while saying this, rest of the course is TERRIBLE. Exams and lectures do not focus on the students capabilities of understanding the general concepts, instead, we focus on high school biology curriculum in a more detailed way. This is not an effective way of teaching biology as it gets boring and uninteresting quite easily, as there are so many details that will definitely be forgotten by non-biology students as we will never ever see them unless we work on a biology related subject. And the worst part of all this is that they expect students to write a cheat sheet on this. Like what is the point of all this? Cheat sheet completely negates all student effort and evaluation of the students understanding of the biology, as literally everyone (somehow) writes the entire 10-12 slides on this piece of paper. What is the point of even trying to deduce biology related results by using our own logical understanding of science, when you know that the guy who never attends the courses and just comes in writing down every sentence in the slides is going to get a better grade than you? I am not saying that you can do all examination by just writing a cheat sheet, but it really negates the importance of  students logical assumptions and deductions. There comes a detail stuff you did not write on the cheat sheet, and you lose marks from the question as you missed it. HWs expects students to deduce some results on the important aspects of the course by utilizing the relevant knowledge. Why are the midterms have to follow this ridiculously interest-killing slides and unrelated details?

course:
The assignments and online quizzes teach the subject very well, however, "biology" the textbook and this course are talking about is kind of old, although today the term "sex" is very binary and not accurate at all it is being used throughout the course, which especially harms the individuals involved in this course (students, assistants or instructors) who identify themselves as trans (especially for those who are nonbinary and gender non-conforming). For those people, if they are not aware of the problems with "biological sex"  (because this term is out of date actually) this course may cause and trigger psychological traumas they encounter regularly in the society. 

Therefore, the instructors should research about how to refer biological aspects of gender without rebuilding binary norms of society in order not to harm any of the trans students (they are not few, anyone who are uncomfortable with gender norms can be included; also, every student is included too because as the course strengthens their binary norms those students are going to harm the trans people with their wrong beliefs)

In addition, this course excludes intersex people too (whose population is 1.8%, higher than red-haired individuals among the society) by constantly referring "he or she" kind of terms, please learn to use "they" as it can be more inclusive.

The possible reaction would be "but this is a biology course, and there are men and women biologically", well, the instructors again should learn why biological sex is not valid and how to refer certain chromosomes, pedigree, inheritance and other topics without rebuilding harmful binary norms. Thanks for reading though, other than these, this course was very interesting.

Rabia da oldukça güler yüzlü, yardımcı ve kibar yaklaştı fakat biraz pasif kaldı. Sadece 2 asistan bence yeterliydi 3 kişiye gerek yoktu. İnci'nin ise bir günü bir gününü tutmadı. Bunu gülerek söylemiş bile olsa bu şekilde bir tehdit içeren cümlenin kullanılması oldukça yanlıştı. Kesinlikle bir master öğrencisine yakışacak bir hareket değildi ve profesyonellikten çok uzak bir hareketti. Bir hafta güler yüzlü, sıcak ve yardımcı davranırken bir hafta agresif, ters ve sinirli davrandı. Her hafta bize "Bizim de işlerimiz var. Sizin sorularınızla uğraşamayız." gibi ifadeler kullandı. Eğer bir derste asistanlık görevi alıyorsa bir master öğrencisi, o dersi alan öğrencilerden gelen dersin labıyla ilgili soruları yanıtlamakla yükümlüdür.
